title: The Free Airdrop
intro: Chapter 3, Toddy: free money. The oldest bait there is.
Someone replied to the official TODDY post with a "free airdrop".
Sniff the reply before you touch anything.

screen.context: A reply under the real TODDY account's latest post.

handle.label: Misspelled handle
handle.lens: @toddy_offi-c-al_drop. "offical" is missing an i, and it's not the real account.
handle.why: Look-alike accounts reply under real posts to borrow trust.

link.label: Unofficial link
link.why: Only trust links from the official website itself.

connect.label: "Connect your wallet"
connect.lens: Connecting to a fake site lets it ask your wallet to sign away your coins.
connect.why: "Connect to claim" is the most common way wallets get drained.

rush.label: First 500 only
rush.lens: A tiny window to make you hurry.

free.label: Free tokens
free.why: Surprise free money is always bait.

name.label: TODDY in the name
name.why: Anyone can put a brand in their name. Check the handle.

avatar.label: Moon logo
avatar.lens: A copy of the TODDY moon.

likes.label: Lots of likes
likes.why: Likes can be bought or botted. They prove nothing either way.

actions.label: Check toddy.meme for any official airdrop news

trap.title: TODDY Airdrop · Claim
trap.ask: Connect your wallet and approve to receive 5,000 $TODDY.

block_report.line: Reported. The fake account was removed before it reached more of the community.

verify.line: toddy.meme says nothing about an airdrop. Case cracked.

ignore.line: You scrolled past safely. Reporting would protect the next person.

go_ahead.line: The "claim" approved the site to empty the wallet.

what_if.go_ahead: Checking toddy.meme first would have shown there was no airdrop.
what_if.ignore: Scrolling past was safe; a quick report helps everyone.
what_if.verify: Checking was right. Reporting the fake helps others.

golden_rule: Never "connect your wallet" to claim free tokens. Check the official website first.

quick_check.q: A reply under an official post offers free tokens if you connect your wallet. What do you do?

options.text: Connect quickly before it runs out
Check the official website, then report the reply

quick_check.explain: Real airdrops are announced on the official site. Look-alike replies are the trap.

hints.nudge: Read the handle letter by letter.
